_doc: Every runtime secret/config the production stack needs. GitHub repo secrets (or variables, kind=var) are the source of truth: CI (scripts/ci/sync_secrets.py) pushes them into Vercel env and, for pod=true, the pod's durable copy. required=true: a deploy fails when the value is missing in GitHub AND in Vercel. See docs/OPERATIONS.md#secrets.

SUPABASE_URL.where: Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API (project URL)

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.where: Cloudflare R2 > Manage API tokens (object read+write)

R2_PUBLIC_URL.where: Cloudflare R2 > bucket > Public access (r2.dev URL or custom domain)

TAPESTRY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.where: console.anthropic.com > API keys (Auto director, idea moderation, Talk to Auto)

RUNPOD_API_KEY.where: runpod.io > Settings > API keys (GPU switch, controller, cost meter)

CONTROLLER_SECRET.where: random 32+ chars; must equal the Supabase Vault secret used by the pg_cron controller ping

GUEST_SECRET.where: random 32+ chars; signs guest sessions (rotating logs guests out)

IP_HASH_SALT.where: random 32+ chars; salts hashed IPs in rate limits/audit (rotating resets them)

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.where: Cloudflare Turnstile > site (public key, also baked into config.js)

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.where: Stripe dashboard (test mode) > Developers > API keys

RUNPOD_MIN_BALANCE.where: USD; the GPU stops when the RunPod balance falls below it

CRON_SECRET.where: random 32+ chars (openssl rand -hex 32); Vercel Cron sends it as Authorization: Bearer to /api/tm jobs

ADMIN_EMAILS.where: comma-separated admin emails (verified Supabase login). No default in code: unset means nobody is admin
